unset QMD_CONFIG_DIR; d="$(mktemp -d)" && export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$d/cache" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$d/config" && qmd --index nasprobe collection add adoption --name adoption > "$d/add.log" 2>&1 && qmd --index nasprobe search "release tag re-pin" -c adoption -n 3 --json > "$d/hit.json" && qmd --index nasprobe search "zyxwvutsrq qqqxyzzy" -c adoption -n 3 --json > "$d/miss.json"; rc=$?; python3 - "$d" <<'PY'
import json, sys, pathlib
d = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
def load(n):
    t = (d / n).read_text().strip()
    try:
        return json.loads(t) if t.startswith('[') else []
    except ValueError:
        return []
hit, miss = load('hit.json'), load('miss.json')
added = [l.strip() for l in (d / 'add.log').read_text().splitlines() if l.startswith('Indexed:')]
print('qmd collection add:', added, '| query "release tag re-pin" top 3:', [(h['file'].split('?')[0], h['score']) for h in hit], '| nonsense query hits', len(miss))
ok = len(hit) == 3 and hit[0]['file'].startswith('qmd://adoption/update.md') and len(miss) == 0 and added
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
ok=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$ok" -eq 0 ]
